description: The restaurant's details: name, contact, opening hours, the home page photo and the About page story. The collection holds a single object; the header, footer and every page read from it.

id.label: ID
id.help: Set automatically to the collection id (info). The templates look the object up by it.

name.label: Restaurant Name
name.help: The restaurant's name as guests know it. Shown in the header, footer and page titles.

tagline.label: Tagline
tagline.help: One short line about the restaurant, shown under the name on the home page. About ten words.

heroImage.label: Home Page Photo
heroImage.help: The large photo beside the restaurant name on the home page. A landscape shot of the dining room or a signature dish works best.

address.label: Address
address.help: Street address on two or three lines, as a guest would type it into a map.

phone.label: Phone
phone.help: Phone number for reservations and questions. Shown as a tap-to-call link.

email.label: Email
email.help: Email address for general questions and private events.

mapUrl.label: Map Link
mapUrl.help: A link to the restaurant on Google Maps or Apple Maps. Used for the Get Directions button.

reservationUrl.label: Reservation Link
reservationUrl.help: Link to the booking page (OpenTable, Resy, etc.). Leave empty to hide the Book a Table buttons.

hours.label: Opening Hours
hours.help: One row per day of the week, in the order they should be listed.

hoursNote.label: Hours Note
hoursNote.help: Optional short note shown under the hours, such as when the kitchen closes or holiday changes.

story.label: Our Story
story.help: The About page text: who runs the restaurant, where the food comes from, what a guest should expect. Three or four short paragraphs.

storyImage.label: Story Photo
storyImage.help: Photo shown beside Our Story on the About page, such as the chef or the kitchen.

updated.label: Updated
updated.help: Set automatically when the object is saved.

created.label: Created
created.help: Set automatically when the object is created.
